answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity with slashing. Each agent locks collateral to register; influence scales with stake, not headcount, so splitting into many fake nodes buys nothing. Random audits check every inlet of activity, and a caught clone forfeits its bond. Attackers must fund each false identity at full price to survive the violet spot-check on the atlas of agents, so cost grows linearly with identities while power does not.
